about.title: À propos de moi
about.subtitle: Développeur passionné par la création de solutions qui résolvent de vrais problèmes
about.description1: Je suis Technicien en Ingénierie du Développement et Gestion de Logiciels et actuellement étudiant en Licence de Développement et Gestion de Logiciels à l'Universidad Tecnológica de Panamá, campus Coclé. Je suis passionné par la création de solutions web complètes — du frontend au backend — et j'aide également les entreprises à se développer grâce à des campagnes Google Ads.
about.description2: J'ai développé des projets allant de systèmes d'audit avec IA à des plateformes e-commerce, en appliquant toujours les meilleures pratiques de développement logiciel sécurisé selon les normes OWASP et NIST, avec des outils tels que Trivy et SonarQube.

about.highlights.item2: Automatisation IA : n8n, Flowise, Ollama, intégration LLMs

proj.nextaudit.title: NextAudit AI
proj.nextaudit.short: SaaS platform for smart security and compliance audits with AI. Reduces audit time from weeks to hours, generating clear and actionable executive reports.
proj.nextaudit.long:
NextAudit AI is a comprehensive SaaS platform that automates the security and compliance audit process using artificial intelligence. It allows managers and directors to obtain clear, actionable executive reports free of technical jargon, reducing audit time from weeks to hours.

It integrates security scanning tools (SAST, DAST, SCA) into a unified pipeline, generates reports with AI, and implements robust authentication with 2FA and role-based access control.

Stack: Angular 21, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, NestJS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, SonarQube, Trivy, OWASP ZAP, JWT, RBAC, Docker, GitHub Actions.
proj.jornada.title: Industrial Journey Coclé
proj.jornada.short: Official institutional website for the UTP Coclé Industrial Journey. Custom WordPress with modular blocks, WCAG 2.1 AA, Lighthouse 98+. Dynamic agenda, live streaming, participant registration.
proj.jornada.long:
Full development of the official website for the Industrial Journey at the Technological University of Panama, Coclé campus. An accessible information platform for students, participating companies, and the general public, featuring a dynamic multi-track agenda, speaker profiles, integrated live broadcasting, and a participant registration area.

Custom WordPress theme developed from scratch with 27 reusable modular blocks. The design prioritizes WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility (certified), performance (Lighthouse Performance 98+, Accessibility 100, Best Practices 96, SEO 100), and a smooth mobile experience.

Stack: WordPress, PHP, MySQL, Customizer API, Google Fonts, Material Symbols, custom modular blocks.
proj.casa.title: La Casa del Jean
proj.casa.short: Full e-commerce for textile retail: 200+ product catalog, persistent cart, checkout, admin panel, WhatsApp + Email notifications.
proj.casa.long:
Complete e-commerce platform for 'La Casa del Jean', a textile retail business. Includes a product catalog with advanced filters (size, color, category, price), persistent cart, integrated checkout, full administration panel (inventory management, orders, customers, sales reports), and automated WhatsApp and email notifications.

Integration of a modern frontend with an existing backend without a complete rewrite, real-time stock synchronization between physical and online stores, and size/color variant management with interactive sales reports.

Stack: Angular, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PHP, MySQL, REST API, RxJS, WhatsApp Business API, EmailJS, Chart.js.
proj.google.title: Digital Advertising + Websites
proj.google.short: Google Ads campaign management to drive qualified traffic to client websites. Goal: get people to click the WhatsApp button and inquire directly.
proj.google.long: Digital advertising service focused on Google Ads for local businesses. The flow is simple and effective: Google Ads (Search) campaigns that drive qualified traffic directly to the client's page, where they will find a WhatsApp button to contact immediately.\n\nEach client receives: Google Ads account setup, keyword strategy, conversion-optimized landing page, and monthly reports with key metrics (CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS).
